problems.title: A rational inequality
problems.question: Solve $3/(x-1)<1$.
problems.idea: Apply the governing formula and verify any restrictions or special cases.
steps: Exclude $x=1$. The fraction is negative for $x<1$ or $x>4$; at 4 it is zero and strictness excludes it.

problems.title: Minimum of an upward parabola
problems.question: Find the minimum of $2x^2+3x+4$.
problems.idea: Apply the governing formula and verify any restrictions or special cases.
steps: $2x^2+3x+4=2(x+3/4)^2+23/8$. The square is nonnegative and can vanish at $x=-3/4$.

problems.title: Inradius of a six-eight-ten triangle
problems.question: Triangle sides are 6,8,10. Find its inradius.
problems.idea: Apply the governing formula and verify any restrictions or special cases.

problems.title: Check an impossible parallelogram height
problems.question: A parallelogram has sides 3,2 and smallest altitude 4. Find the largest altitude.
problems.idea: Apply the governing formula and verify any restrictions or special cases.
steps: The smaller altitude is to the longer side 3. Its formal area would be $3\cdot4=12$, giving the other altitude $12/2=6$.
But an altitude to side 3 cannot exceed the other side 2. The stated altitude 4 is impossible.
problems.answer: No such parallelogram exists; 6 is the formal intended choice.
problems.note: The area ratio calculation alone gives a listed number, but the given side lengths and height cannot occur together.

problems.title: Oddness with a period of three
problems.question: $f$ is odd, has period 3, and $f(4)=-2$. Find $f(-7)$.
problems.idea: Apply the governing formula and verify any restrictions or special cases.
steps: $f(7)=f(4)=-2$ by periodicity. Oddness then gives $f(-7)=2$.

problems.title: Absolute value does not change zeros
problems.question: The roots of $f(x)=0$ are $\{-3,-2,1\}$. Find the roots of $|f(x)|=0$.
problems.idea: Apply the governing formula and verify any restrictions or special cases.
steps: The equations are equivalent, so their solution sets coincide.

problems.title: Area from two perpendicular medians
problems.question: Two perpendicular triangle medians have lengths 3 and 4.5. Find the area.
problems.idea: Apply the governing formula and verify any restrictions or special cases.
formulas: The centroid takes $2/3$ of each median from a vertex; its three vertex triangles have equal areas.
steps: The centroid-to-vertex segments have lengths 2 and 3 and are perpendicular, so their triangle has area $2\cdot3/2=3$.
The whole triangle has three times that area, hence 9.

problems.title: Areas cut out by trapezoid diagonals
problems.question: Three of the four triangles formed by a trapezoid’s diagonals have areas 1,2,2. Find the trapezoid area.
problems.idea: Apply the governing formula and verify any restrictions or special cases.
formulas: The two lateral triangle areas are equal; the product of the base-adjacent areas equals their common area squared.
steps: The equal lateral areas must be 2 and 2, leaving a base-adjacent area 1. If the remaining base-adjacent area is $t$, then $1\cdot t=2^2$, giving $t=4$.
For completeness, taking the lateral areas as 1,1 would force the two given base areas 2,2 to have product 1, a contradiction. Thus there is no second arrangement.
Total area is $1+2+2+4=9$.

problems.title: Multiply roots as fractional powers
problems.question: Evaluate $\sqrt{199}\sqrt[3]{199}\sqrt[6]{199}$.
problems.idea: Apply the governing formula and verify any restrictions or special cases.
formulas: Add exponents for the same positive base.
steps: The exponent is $1/2+1/3+1/6=1$, so the product is 199.

problems.title: Clock-hand length from tip travel
problems.question: The minute-hand tip travels 20 cm in 25 minutes. Find the hand length.
problems.idea: Apply the governing formula and verify any restrictions or special cases.

problems.title: Integers between two irrational endpoints
problems.question: How many natural numbers lie between $100^{1/3}$ and $5^{3/2}$?
problems.idea: Apply the governing formula and verify any restrictions or special cases.
steps: The lower endpoint is between 4 and 5; the upper is $\sqrt{125}$ between 11 and 12.
The natural numbers are 5 through 11, seven values.

problems.title: Order three different forms of numbers
problems.question: Order $a=8^{-2/3}$, $b=\sqrt[4]3$, $c=3/16$.
problems.idea: Apply the governing formula and verify any restrictions or special cases.

problems.title: Possible remainder modulo fourteen
problems.question: $a\equiv5\pmod7$. Which listed remainder modulo 14 is possible?
problems.idea: Apply the governing formula and verify any restrictions or special cases.
steps: Even $k$ gives remainder 5; odd $k$ gives remainder 12. Only 12 is listed.

problems.title: Polygon angle from its diagonal count
problems.question: A regular polygon has 170 diagonals. Find an interior angle.
problems.idea: Apply the governing formula and verify any restrictions or special cases.
steps: The interior angle is $180-18=162^\circ$.

problems.title: Octagon area from its circumradius
problems.question: A regular octagon is inscribed in a circle of radius $\sqrt[4]2$. Find its area.
problems.idea: Apply the governing formula and verify any restrictions or special cases.
steps: Here $R^2=\sqrt2$, so $S=4\sqrt2\sin45^\circ=4$.

problems.title: Simplify exponents before substitution
problems.question: Evaluate $(x^3/y^{10})^{1/5}x^{-8/5}y^4$ at $x=199,y=5$.
problems.idea: Apply the governing formula and verify any restrictions or special cases.
steps: Combine powers to get $x^{-1}y^2$. Substitute to obtain $25/199$.

problems.title: Find an unknown power
problems.question: To what power should $4^{1/3}$ be raised to obtain $16^{1/5}$?
problems.idea: Apply the governing formula and verify any restrictions or special cases.
formulas: Write both bases as powers of 2.

problems.title: Count two-digit members of a congruence class
problems.question: How many two-digit natural numbers satisfy $x\equiv7\pmod{22}$?
problems.idea: Apply the governing formula and verify any restrictions or special cases.
steps: The two-digit values are 29,51,73,95. The preceding value is 7 and the next 117, outside the range.

problems.title: Inradius-to-circumradius ratio of a regular hexagon
problems.question: Find the ratio of the inscribed and circumscribed circle radii of a regular hexagon.
problems.idea: Apply the governing formula and verify any restrictions or special cases.
steps: Bisect a centre triangle. For $n=6$, $r/R=\cos30^\circ=\sqrt3/2$.

problems.title: An equilateral triangle inside a regular pentagon
problems.question: Inside regular $ABCDE$, triangle $BCK$ is equilateral. Find $AKB$.
problems.idea: Apply the governing formula and verify any restrictions or special cases.
formulas: A regular pentagon’s interior angle is $108^\circ$; equal sides imply equal base angles.
steps: $AB=BC=BK$. At $B$, $ABK=108^\circ-60^\circ=48^\circ$.
Isosceles $ABK$ then has $AKB=(180^\circ-48^\circ)/2=66^\circ$.

problems.title: Reject one incongruent number
problems.question: Which listed number cannot be $x$ if $29\equiv x\pmod{22}$?
problems.idea: Apply the governing formula and verify any restrictions or special cases.
formulas: Congruent integers differ by a multiple of 22.
steps: The numbers 29,73,7,51,95 differ from 29 by $0,44,-22,22,66$.
62 differs by 33, which is not divisible by 22.

problems.title: Rationality of powers of prime roots
problems.question: $a=19^{1/7},b=19^{1/11},c=19^{1/13}$. Which has rational 199th power?
problems.idea: Apply the governing formula and verify any restrictions or special cases.
formulas: A rational power $p^{u/v}$ of a prime is rational only when the reduced exponent has denominator 1.
steps: The exponents are $199/7,199/11,199/13$. None is an integer because none of 7,11,13 divides 199.
Prime factorization therefore rules out rationality in all three cases.

problems.title: Roots straddling one
problems.question: Which listed $a$ makes $24x^2-10ax+a^2=0$ have one root above 1 and one below 1?
problems.idea: Apply the governing formula and verify any restrictions or special cases.
steps: The roots are $a/4,a/6$. To straddle 1, require $a/6<1<a/4$, or $4<a<6$.
Only $a=5$ is listed in this interval.

problems.title: Area of a sector in radians
problems.question: A sector has radius $\sqrt2$ and central angle $\alpha$ radians. Find its area.
problems.idea: Apply the governing formula and verify any restrictions or special cases.
steps: Substitute $R^2=2$ to obtain $S=\alpha$.

problems.title: An impossible regular-polygon exterior angle
problems.question: Which of $5^\circ,6^\circ,7^\circ,8^\circ,9^\circ,10^\circ$ cannot be an exterior angle of a regular polygon?
problems.idea: Apply the governing formula and verify any restrictions or special cases.
formulas: The vertex count must be the integer $n=360^\circ/\theta$.
steps: The angles 5,6,8,9,10 give counts 72,60,45,40,36. But $360/7$ is not an integer.
